title: 熱帯魚アクアリウム
world: calm, premium home aquarium viewing experience at night; soft water, glass and air bubbles; quiet, intimate, never loud or cartoonish

sounds.name: 水槽に寄る
sounds.prompt: slow soft airy underwater whoosh with a few gentle rising air bubbles, muffled water swell
sounds.use: the camera glides from the living room into an aquarium tank and the view goes underwater; calm and immersive, no splash impact, no voice, no music

sounds.name: 部屋に戻る
sounds.prompt: soft airy whoosh rising out of water, gentle muffled water surfacing, light room tone opening up
sounds.use: the camera pulls back out of the aquarium into a bright quiet living room; gentle, no splash, no voice

sounds.name: 隣の水槽へ
sounds.prompt: short soft water swish sideways, gentle current movement with tiny bubbles
sounds.use: the view slides from one aquarium to the next aquarium; brief, soft, no splash impact

sounds.name: 設定を閉じる
sounds.prompt: soft muted glass panel sliding closed, gentle low airy slide
sounds.use: the frosted glass settings panel slides away to return to viewing; very soft, slightly lower than opening

sounds.name: ボタン
sounds.prompt: tiny soft glass tick, delicate muted tap on thick aquarium glass
sounds.use: the viewer taps a quiet interface button such as a tab, zoom or lighting choice; tiny and refined, not a game coin or beep

sounds.name: 生き物を増やす
sounds.prompt: single small soft bubble bloop rising in water
sounds.use: one fish is added to the aquarium; a single gentle bubble, cute but natural, no splash

sounds.name: 生き物を減らす
sounds.prompt: single small soft lower bubble bloop sinking in water
sounds.use: one fish is taken out of the aquarium; gentle and slightly lower pitched than adding, no splash

sounds.name: 水景を変える
sounds.prompt: slow gentle swirl of water with soft shimmering bubbles settling
sounds.use: the aquarium's planted scenery crossfades to a different aquascape; calm and magical but natural, no splash, no music

sounds.name: 照明を変える
sounds.prompt: soft quiet click of an aquarium LED light switch with a faint warm hum swell
sounds.use: the aquarium lighting changes between daylight, cool, evening and night; one soft switch click, no buzz
